details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this follower. [fanfare] Summon a Paper Shikigami token. [act] Bury a Shikigami follower: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 4 damage. For the rest of this turn, this card's [act] abilities except [evolve] can't be activated.

issues: The activated ability is missing the clause "For the rest of this turn, this card's [act] abilities except [evolve] can't be activated." It should encode a sequence that deals 4 damage, then applies grantActRestriction with {"exceptEvolve": true, "untilEndOfTurn": true}.
The bury cost for the activated ability is not encoded in the supported cost shape. It should use a valid activated cost that buries 1 Shikigami follower from your field.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Worldreaver's Descent & Dominion of Darkness"
details.effect: While Overflow is active for you, this card has [quick]. ---------- Select an enemy follower on the field. Deal it 4 damage and summon a Naterran Great Tree token.

issues: Quick is incorrectly placed in top-level keywords. The source says the card has [quick] only while Overflow is active, so remove "quick" from keywords and keep it only as a passive conditional keyword-grant.
The spell ability is incorrectly marked "quick": true unconditionally. Quick should only be granted by the passive Overflow condition, not always on the spell ability.
